title: chart text horizontal
rule: Keep chart text horizontal; long categories → horizontal bar, don’t rotate. If a tool forces rotation, cap 45° and keep ≥12px at all viewports. Min sizes: title 16–18px, data labels 12px, notes 11–12px. Y-axis labels right-aligned; X centred. Commas in thousands; no digit spaces (AT).
pass_when: Labels stay horizontal (or ≤45° if the tool forces rotation, ≥12px); long categories use a horizontal bar; thousands use commas not spaces.
fail_when: Rotated labels to avoid a horizontal bar; digit spaces in thousands.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
